comment: Read from src/Euler.cpp at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1. The FREQ knob runs from -8 to 4 and is shown as two to that power in hertz (Euler.cpp:52), so the range is about 0.004Hz to 16Hz with 2Hz at the default. The measurement interval is two divided by that frequency in samples, clamped to between 1 and 1024 (Euler.cpp:85), which the manual does not mention; at the slow end the module measures rarely and the output steps. The 31.5 in the angle formula at Euler.cpp:88 is the scaling that makes a one hertz sine measured at a FREQ of one hertz come out as its cosine, as the manual describes. The module has no context menu of its own.
